description.v: Swish is a 10-minute food delivery platform that owns its kitchens, technology, and last-mile delivery. Founded in Bengaluru in 2024, it operates a network of neighbourhood kitchens (Delight Centers) with robotic equipment, delivering fresh meals within ~1km radius. Menu spans 250+ SKUs across 20+ food categories.
